	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to make to stand⟫, ⟪to place⟫, ⟪set⟫, ⟪set up⟫, ⟪establish⟫, ⟪appoint⟫: c. acc. pers., ⟦Mark 7:9|Mk 7:9⟧, ⟦Acts 1:23|Ac 1:23⟧ ⟦Acts 6:13|6:13⟧ ⟦Acts 17:31|17:31⟧, ⟦Hebrews 10:9|He 10:9⟧; id. seq. ἐπί, c. acc. loc., ⟦Matthew 4:5|Mt 4:5⟧, ⟦Luke 4:9|Lk 4:9⟧; ἐν μέσῳ, ⟦Matthew 18:2|Mt 18:2⟧, ⟦Mark 9:36|Mk 9:36⟧, ⟦John 8:3|Jo 8:[3]⟧; ἐνώπιον, ⟦Acts 6:6|Ac 6:6⟧; παρ’ ἑαυτῷ, ⟦Luke 9:47|Lk 9:47⟧; ἐκ δεξιῶν, ⟦Matthew 25:33|Mt 25:33⟧; mid., ⟪to place oneself⟫, ⟪to stand⟫: ⟦Revelation 18:15|Re 18:15⟧; so also pass., ⟪to be made to stand⟫, ⟪to stand⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:9|Mt 2:9⟧, ⟦Luke 11:18|Lk 11:18⟧ ⟦Luke 19:8|19:8⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 13:1|II Co 13:1⟧, al.

(with sense of pres. and impf.; M, Pr., 147 f.) and 2 aor. act., ⟪to stand⟫, ⟪stand by⟫, ⟪stand still⟫: ⟦Matthew 20:32|Mt 20:32⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:73|26:73⟧, ⟦Mark 10:49|Mk 10:49⟧, ⟦Luke 8:44|Lk 8:44⟧, ⟦John 1:35|Jo 1:35⟧ ⟦John 3:29|3:29⟧, ⟦Acts 16:9|Ac 16:9⟧, al.; seq. ἐν, ⟦Matthew 6:5|Mt 6:5⟧, al.; ἐνώπιον, ⟦Acts 10:30|Ac 10:30⟧, al.; πρός, c. dat. loc., ⟦John 18:16|Jo 18:16⟧; ἐπί, c. gen. loc., ⟦Luke 6:17|Lk 6:17⟧, ⟦Acts 5:23|Ac 5:23⟧ ⟦Acts 25:10|25:10⟧, al.; ἔμπροσθεν, ⟦Matthew 27:11|Mt 27:11⟧; κύκλῳ, ⟦Revelation 7:11|Re 7:11⟧; ἐκ δεξιῶν, ⟦Luke 1:11|Lk 1:11⟧; ἐπί, c. acc., ⟦Matthew 13:2|Mt 13:2⟧, ⟦Revelation 3:20|Re 3:20⟧; παρά, ⟦Luke 5:2|Lk 5:2⟧; ἐκεῖ, ⟦Mark 11:5|Mk 11:5⟧; ὧδε, ⟦Mark 9:1|Mk 9:1⟧; ὅπου, ⟦Mark 13:14|Mk 13:14⟧; ἔξω, ⟦Matthew 12:46|Mt 12:46⟧; μακρόθεν, ⟦Luke 18:13|Lk 18:13⟧; πόρρωθεν, ⟦Luke 17:12|Lk 17:12⟧.
